Śrī_kṛṣṇa
--Gītāsārā. Nabadwip 13. Refers to God Kṛṣṇa ?

Śrī_kṛṣṇa
--C. Vyākhyā on Saundaryalaharī. Mithilā. See below Kṛṣṇadāsa Tarkālaṅkāra an. his C. on same, L. 2415, RASB. VIII. B. 6692.

Śrī_kṛṣṇa
of the Maṇḍa family of Ṣaṭkheṭaka, a city on the confluence of the Godāvarī an. the Sindhu.
--C. Bhāṣya on Caraka saṁhitā mentioned by his descendant Rudra Bhaṭṭa in his C. on Vaidyajīvana.
--Sāhityasudhāsamudra. BBRAS. 198.

Śrī_kṛṣṇabhaṭṭa
of Mauni family; son of Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa an. Jānakī (whose other three sons are Mahādeva, Rāmakṛṣṇa an. Jayakṛṣṇa); grandson of Govardhana Bhaṭṭa an. younger brother of Jayakṛṣṇa; an. pupil of Mādhavendra Sarasvatī. See Adyar D. VI. 320. Some Catalogues confuse a. an. his [Page339-a. brother Jayakṛṣṇa, under whom are given some of the works noted below.
--Ākhyātārthacandrikā(nirṇaya). NCC. II. p. 11a.
--Kārakavāda or Vibhaktyarthanirṇaya. gr.
See NCC. III. p. 376.
